title: Under Armour Welcomes NFL Star Tee Higgins to its Football Roster
summary: Under Armour welcomes Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins as the newest addition to its football roster. As an Under Armour athlete, Higgins will represent the brand on and off the field, showcasing Under Armour footwear, apparel and accessories. He will also be featured in marketing initiatives, including future extensions of Under Armour's WE LOVE FOOTBALL series.
body_markdown:
A proven performer at every level of the game, Higgins has established himself as a leading NFL wide receiver through his playmaking ability, consistency and leadership. Since entering the league, he has become a cornerstone of the Bengals' offense and one of football's most dynamic receiving threats.


This partnership builds on a longstanding connection between Higgins and Under Armour. As one of the nation's top high school football players, Higgins participated in the 2017 UA Next All-America Game before going on to star at Clemson and then establishing himself among the NFL's top pass catchers. Beyond his success on the field, Higgins is passionate about creating opportunities for young athletes and giving back to his community, which he sees as an important area of collaboration with Under Armour.
